featured.title: Software Raytracer
featured.desc: A CPU based path tracer. Simulates light rays bouncing and refracting around a scene to create a realistic image. Supports reflective materials, glass and emissive materials

featured.title: Rigid Body Physics Simulation
featured.desc: Simulates ropes, cloth, springs, and planets using a variation of the Semi-implicit Euler Method. Optimized to handle thousands of objects on a single thread. Fully deterministic

featured.title: Retro Render Engine
featured.desc: Rendering engine based on DOOM and Quake. Uses ray casts to approximate 3d graphics. Built with a fully featured level editor, textures, doors, and transparency

featured.title: Falling Sand
featured.desc: A series of falling sand simulations. Simulates a gamified version of a variety of materials, including sand, water, lava, acid, and many more. Each simulation built on the last, and each offers something unique

list.title: Digital Yondr Replacement
list.sub: Uses screen time API and NFC tags to allow for school districts to restrict phone usage during school hours.

list.title: Dynamic Planet Renderer
list.sub: Renders a planet as a dynamic LOD mesh that increases resolution as the camera approaches to optimize performance.

list.title: Fantasy Emulator
list.sub: A fully custom bytecode and assembly language. Builds assembly files into bytecode directly. Has graphics support built-in.

list.title: Homebrew Compiler
list.sub: A compiler for a custom language. Can compile to machine code or run as an interpreter

list.title: Minimal Desktop Station
list.sub: Setup many centrally accessible desktop stations on a server for minimal cost, PXE boot to centralized OS image.
